accounting.rationale: Original physical PDF119, printed105, lines2-3 defines automatic data objects through six retained predicates. This is a source classification, not a requirement to use a stack, a storage-size promise, or a new no-op S execution.

The data object is not a dummy argument. PENDING finite source-use comparison of a dummy with a nonconstant explicit bound and a nondummy local with the same bound; only the latter meets this antecedent. Do not make SAVE on the dummy a valid C814 repair: C862 independently excludes it.

The subject is a data object, not an arbitrary data entity or constructor value. PENDING source-use binding to 3.42, 5.4.3.2.1/.3, R604/R605 and R902/C901/C902. Named constants belong to the data-object category but C853 constrains their parameter/bound expressions. No direct RANK(array-constructor) classifier is permitted.

One route is a type parameter depending on the specified nonconstant expression. PENDING finite contexts: CHARACTER length in either declaration position and a complete PDT LEN parameter. C701 still requires constant KIND parameters. A nondeferred variable length can meet the predicate on a POINTER or ALLOCATABLE scalar; those attributes alone do not negate it.

The other route is an array bound, not rank, arbitrary array size, or allocation as an implementation technique. PENDING ordinary explicit-shape bounds from an eligible dummy value or nonconstant SIZE inquiry. Bounds capture remains canonically 8.5.8.2/8.5.8.4, not another local p2 type-parameter effect.

The expression is a specification-expr under R1029/C1011 and 10.1.11: scalar INTEGER, restricted, in a permitted scope, with prior type/parameter information. PENDING source-use of explicit typing, legitimate implicit typing and host/use routes. OPTIONAL/INTENT(OUT) dummy values and an ordinary local initialized integer are not silently admitted as value primaries.

The specification expression is not a constant expression under 10.1.12. PENDING contrast between a dummy-dependent bound and a constant named parameter or constant inquiry into previously fixed bounds/length. Mentioning a variable in LEN/SIZE need not make an inquiry nonconstant; one observed value, an optimizer result, a deferred colon, or an assumed asterisk does not decide this classification.
Original PDF119 line4; official ownership is retained. No C814 primary execution exists in the committed1972-case baseline.

Original PDF119 lines5-9: nonconstant type-parameter establishment for local variables of subprograms/BLOCK constructs, with two declaration positions, two entry events and two kinds of later source-variable change.

3.151.2 supplies the local-variable meaning; it excludes dummy arguments/parts, global entities/parts and entities/parts accessible outside that scoping unit. This predicate is not interchangeable with p1's nondummy-data-object definition.
The invariance is during the corresponding procedure/BLOCK execution, not a promise to reuse the first invocation's value forever or an ordering rule among different specification expressions.

requirements.title: Automatic data objects cannot have SAVE
requirements.source: 8.3 C814 and p1 antecedent, physical PDF119, printed105, lines2-4
requirements.definition: SAVE is excluded for an automatic data object as defined by p1: a nondummy data object with a type parameter or array bound depending on a nonconstant specification expression. The formal expression and entity predicates matter, not observed size, storage placement, or simply the appearance of a variable name in an inquiry. An inferred SAVE has not become harmless merely because no SAVE keyword appears, but initialization and other inferred routes retain their own restrictions.

pending.character-selector-save: PENDING compile diagnostic/control plan. In a complete procedure, a previously typed nonoptional INTEGER INTENT(IN) dummy n supplies CHARACTER(LEN=n) for a nondummy local with SAVE and no initializer. Remove only SAVE and its comma. Require a located automatic/nonconstant-length entity versus SAVE cause, not a generic complaint that n is nonconstant.
pending.character-entity-length-save: PENDING the same qualified dummy-value context with an individual entity length *(n), correct R723 parentheses and SAVE. Remove only SAVE. Keep this declaration position distinct from the CHARACTER selector and do not accept a malformed suffix or unsupported CHARACTER facility as the intended diagnostic.
pending.explicit-bound-save: PENDING ordinary INTEGER local a(n) with SAVE, where n is a previously typed eligible dummy value. Delete only SAVE; the repair remains a nondummy automatic array. It has no initializer, deferred shape, POINTER or ALLOCATABLE attribute, so no C808/C834 defect masks this relation.
pending.pdt-length-save: PENDING a complete visible PDT with one LEN parameter and an ordinary INTEGER array component bounded by it; a local TYPE(t(n)) object has SAVE and no initializer. Remove only SAVE. Its KIND parameters, if any, are constant and never guessed intrinsic kind codes. Unsupported PDT machinery or a wrong component specification is not C814 evidence.
pending.fixed-length-allocatable-save: PENDING scalar CHARACTER(LEN=n), ALLOCATABLE, SAVE with eligible nonconstant n and no initialization. Remove only SAVE. The nondeferred length, not the later allocation, gives the automatic-object premise. Do not introduce an illegal explicit-shape allocatable array or read unallocated data.
pending.fixed-length-pointer-save: PENDING scalar CHARACTER(LEN=n), POINTER, SAVE with no initialization. Remove only SAVE; its nondeferred length is the selected premise. No pointer target, association inquiry or C770 lifetime defect is introduced. A POINTER attribute is not a universal exemption from automatic classification.
pending.inquiry-dependent-bound-save: PENDING local INTEGER a(SIZE(arg)) with SAVE, where arg is an assumed-shape INTEGER dummy in a complete explicit-interface procedure. Its extent is not a constant expression. Remove only SAVE; distinguish the actual automatic/SAVE cause from missing-interface, wrong-rank or unsupported inquiry reports.
pending.constant-specification-admission: PENDING compile controls with SAVE on ordinary locals whose lengths/bounds use a prior INTEGER PARAMETER, LEN of a previously fixed-length CHARACTER object, or SIZE of a previously fixed-shape ordinary array. Those inquiries can be constant expressions without reading payload. Contrast the formal inquiry premises, not observed values or a named constant itself given SAVE.
pending.bare-save-admission: PENDING complete procedure with a permitted automatic local and a SAVE statement with no list, but no other SAVE specification. R859/8.6.14p1 include only allowed items; C893 remains satisfied. This is not a BLOCK control: C1108 requires a list in BLOCK. A SAVE outside a BLOCK does not save that BLOCK's local construct entities.

requirements.oracle: Seven focused automatic/SAVE report-control families and two bounded compile-admission families. Each negative is otherwise conforming and its repair changes only the selected SAVE specification. Numbered reporting capability permits an ordinary0 or nonzero return with a real located causal report; neither fatal rejection nor particular English wording is mandated.
requirements.oracle_limitation: All facets are pending, with no fixtures or reports. A valid control is not made by turning the object into a dummy or function result, which C862 separately excludes from explicit SAVE. C808/C880 initializer prohibitions and main/module nonconstant-specification restrictions must not be used as substitute causes. Reject bare SAVE/constant words, source echoes, unrelated declarations, unsupported facilities, Internal/ASR/crash/resource failures and generic recovery. No unsaved-value trap, forced memory clearing, stack layout or byte-width oracle.

requirements.title: Nonconstant local type parameters are established at entry
requirements.definition: For a local variable of a subprogram or BLOCK, a type parameter defined by a nonconstant expression in the declaration-type-spec or individual char-length is established upon entry to a procedure defined by that subprogram, or execution of the BLOCK statement. Redefining or undefining variables used by the expression does not change that established parameter during the corresponding execution. This is not the separate array-bound capture rule and does not turn deferred or assumed markers into ordinary nonconstant expressions.

pending.procedure-selector-snapshot: PENDING runtime effect. A complete procedure receives defined nonoptional INTEGER INTENT(INOUT) n=2; a local CHARACTER(LEN=n) variable has no declaration initializer. Define its text in the body, change n to5, and check LEN of that data object against literal2, not against n or another affected object.
pending.procedure-entity-length-snapshot: PENDING the same finite procedure-entry effect using individual *(n), with initial n=3 and later n=7. Define the CHARACTER value by executable assignment and independently require length3 after the change. No implied SAVE from declaration initialization.
pending.block-selector-snapshot: PENDING runtime BLOCK entered with a defined host integer n=3. Declare local CHARACTER(LEN=n), define its payload, change host n to7 in the block body and require LEN3. The expression is restricted through host association; all specification evaluation precedes the body mutation.
pending.block-entity-length-snapshot: PENDING BLOCK effect using individual *(n), with n=2 at entry and n=5 later. Observe the local object's defined length2. Do not assume a lexical left-to-right order among BLOCK specification expressions.
pending.pdt-length-snapshot: PENDING runtime local object of one complete PDT with a LEN parameter n=2 and an ordinary INTEGER array component. After entry define every component element, change the source dummy to5, and independently require parameter2, component extent2 and the assigned literal values. LEN is not a runtime KIND selector, and an arbitrary PDT LEN is not universally a CHARACTER length.
pending.fixed-length-descriptor-snapshot: PENDING two finite runtime contexts with local nondeferred CHARACTER(LEN=n) ALLOCATABLE and POINTER scalars, initially n=2. Change n to5 after entry; allocate the allocatable without a new type-spec or associate the pointer with a live, defined, matching-length target. Check established length2 and defined text. Keep allocation/association separate from entry capture; do not replace the fixed length with colon or inspect unavailable deferred parameters.
pending.post-undefinition-snapshot: PENDING procedure and BLOCK contexts entered with source integer3 and a subsequently defined local CHARACTER object. Invoke a complete INTEGER INTENT(OUT) helper that leaves only that source integer undefined. Check the local object's still-defined LEN against3 without referencing the source integer, then restore the source by assignment of a literal before any later use. No memory poisoning, requirement for a changed bit pattern, undefined-value comparison or runtime trap is an oracle.
pending.fresh-entry-captures: PENDING two procedure invocations with independently supplied2 and4 and two executions of the same BLOCK with3 and5. Mutate each source value after entry and check every local length against its own input literal, with an explicit count of all observations. Do not reuse the first captured value across later executions or compare only the two outputs with one another.
pending.nested-block-snapshots: PENDING nested BLOCKs: source integer3 before the outer entry,5 before the inner entry, then7 inside the inner body. Define both local CHARACTER values and independently check lengths3 and5 while both objects are alive. No address/stack-size observer and no assumption about unspecified ordering of separate specification expressions.

requirements.oracle: All planned executions observe defined local type parameters against independent small integers; text/component values are defined before value reads. Repeated and nested entries prevent a one-time global capture from standing in for the per-entry rule. Undefinition is a source state transition, not permission to observe an undefined source value.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No negative twin for this effect and no downgrade to compile-only when a feature is unsupported. Array-bound invariance, deferred-parameter changes and alternate procedure/result roles remain their canonical dependencies, not silently added p2 obligations. Source-use infrastructure remains pending. RANK requires a DATA OBJECT: no direct RANK constructor/expression probe, and no fixed-rank destination used to prove a constructor's rank. If such a separate witness is needed later, use a correctly associated assumed-rank dummy data object with the original C839/C840 and argument rules.

review_rationale: Independent original six-unit automatic-object/initialization source review in doc/source_audits/batch_027.json. Exact entity/constant-expression, local-entry, DATA/default-initialization, conversion, overlap/shape, association and SAVE conditions and all53finite pending plans are preserved. No fixture, source-use census, processor observation or approval of the remaining policy/representation/lifetime qualifications is supplied.
